## Checked

CI runs the gates. These are the parts it cannot see — or run the
`design-review` skill, which walks the same list.

- [ ] Holds at phone width and at the breakpoint edges (640, 1024)
- [ ] Checked in all three themes, light and dark
- [ ] Loading, empty, and error states, where content can be absent or slow
- [ ] Keyboard pass: reachable, operable, visible focus
- [ ] Motion is off under `prefers-reduced-motion`
- [ ] Copy is in the dictionary or MDX, in the site's voice
- [ ] Nothing internal from an employer or client is in the diff
